blocker_audit.finding: For toilets not directly accessed, the raw PDF requires a 1800 x 1800 mm turning space and clear transfer space of at least 750 mm adjacent to the water closet. The 900 x 1500 mm WC-clearance claim was not supported in the accessible toilet section.

blocker_audit.finding: The 450 mm value in the raw PDF is not side-transfer clearance; it is the sidewall-to-water-closet-centerline installation dimension and the toilet-seat height. Transfer space is at least 750 mm where required.

blocker_audit.finding: The raw PDF supports toilet grab bars installed 300 mm above the top of the toilet seat, not a blanket 750-850 mm above finished floor. It also specifies an L-type vertical leg extending 750 mm above the horizontal grab bar.

txt lines 1151-1154: both grab bars installed 300 mm high from top of toilet seat to top of grab bars

blocker_audit.finding: The raw PDF supports a flip-up grab bar capable of fully supporting a minimum weight of 200 kg. The 1.3 kN capacity claim was not supported in the audited accessible toilet section.
